title: Classic Italian Craftsmanship Meets Modern Luxury On This 105-Foot Motoryacht
description: Babieca, a 2005 Azimut 105, presents an exceptional opportunity for discerning yacht buyers seeking established quality and proven performance in the Miami market.
html:
Babieca represents the pinnacle of early 2000s Italian yacht design, a 2005 Azimut 105 currently positioned in Miami and ready for her next chapter. Built during Azimut’s golden era of innovation, this vessel embodies the brand’s commitment to seamless integration of performance, comfort, and aesthetic refinement that has defined the Azimut name for decades.

The 105-foot platform provides an impressive volume of living space across multiple decks, with the signature Azimut design language evident in every curve and proportion. The yacht’s exterior profile speaks to purposeful engineering—a sleek, modern silhouette that cuts through water with authority while maintaining the elegant proportions that make Azimut vessels instantly recognizable in any anchorage. The flybridge represents one of Babieca’s most compelling features, offering an expansive outdoor entertaining area that captures the essence of Mediterranean cruising. Fitted with comfortable seating, a full wet bar, and a spa tub, this space transforms into an open-air sanctuary for owners and guests seeking respite under the sun. The thoughtful layout ensures that multiple guests can enjoy the space simultaneously without compromising comfort or sightlines across the water.

Below decks, Babieca’s interior accommodations reflect the sophisticated tastes of her designers. The main salon flows naturally from the galley, creating an open-plan living environment that maximizes natural light and ventilation. Multiple staterooms provide comfortable quarters for family and guests, each appointed with the quality finishes and attention to detail that distinguish Azimut vessels from their competitors. The master suite occupies a commanding position with private access and en-suite facilities that rival five-star hotel accommodations. The helm station demonstrates the technological sophistication embedded throughout the vessel. Modern navigation and control systems provide the captain with comprehensive oversight of all major systems, while the forward visibility ensures confident maneuvering in any condition. The design philosophy prioritizes both functionality and ergonomics, allowing for extended periods at the helm without fatigue.

Propulsion comes from twin diesel engines that deliver the performance characteristics expected from a vessel of this caliber. The power plant provides sufficient thrust for comfortable cruising speeds while maintaining the fuel efficiency that owners appreciate during extended voyages. The engineering spaces are well-appointed and accessible, facilitating routine maintenance and inspections. The deck layout demonstrates Azimut’s understanding of how owners actually use their vessels. The foredeck features comfortable lounging areas with integrated sun pads, while the aft deck provides multiple entertaining zones that can be configured for formal dinners or casual gatherings. Teak accents throughout the exterior add warmth and authenticity to the modern composite construction.

Babieca’s current location in Miami positions her ideally for owners seeking immediate access to the Caribbean’s finest cruising grounds. The South Florida market offers unparalleled support infrastructure, from world-class marinas to specialized service facilities, ensuring that ownership remains hassle-free and enjoyable. The vessel’s proven track record and established systems mean that new owners can begin their adventures with confidence. The 2005 construction year places Babieca at an advantageous point in the pre-owned market—mature enough to have benefited from real-world refinement and proven reliability, yet modern enough to incorporate the technological advances that contemporary owners expect. This balance between heritage and contemporary capability makes the Azimut 105 platform particularly attractive to experienced yacht owners.

For those evaluating options in the 100-plus-foot range, Babieca merits serious consideration. The combination of Italian design excellence, proven engineering, and the practical advantages of Miami-based ownership creates a compelling proposition. The vessel awaits new owners ready to embrace the lifestyle that only a yacht of this caliber can provide, offering immediate access to world-class cruising and the freedom that comes with true maritime capability.
